reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's V1 (recommended-to-ship) model: ks_yaw_rate(v, delta, L_platform) minus per-segment straight-line yaw-gyro bias, computed per the agent's run_ladder.py recipe; bias recomputed on each canonical segment using the same straight-mask threshold (|delta_road|<0.01) and >5-sample rule.
notes: Agent only fit/recommended on FORD_MUSTANG_MACH_E_MK1 (315 segs); for F-150 Lightning the V1 recipe is applied with platform L=3.70 m and bias computed per-segment from the segment's own straight-line samples, which is what the agent's pipeline would do if pointed at those segments. baseline recomputed = 0.014740020893 vs canonical 0.014740020893 (diff 0.00e+00).
